question: Add a new method ExplainQuery(ctx context.Context, qs string) (*QueryPlan, error) to the QueryEngine interface in promql. QueryEngine is used by Thanos query frontend for distributed PromQL evaluation and by Grafana for direct Prometheus queries. All implementations must add this method.

new_type_required.description: QueryPlan is a new struct that must be defined in promql/engine.go to represent the execution plan for a PromQL query. It should be placed near the QueryEngine interface definition.

files_to_modify.details: 1) Add ExplainQuery method to QueryEngine interface at line 127. 2) Define new QueryPlan struct near the interface. 3) Add ExplainQuery method implementation on Engine struct (which is defined at line 345). The Engine struct currently implements QueryEngine via NewInstantQuery (line 531) and NewRangeQuery (line 552). The ExplainQuery implementation should parse the expression using ng.parser.ParseExpr(qs) and return a *QueryPlan containing the parsed expression tree.

Mimir's streaming Engine struct (line 152) implements promql.QueryEngine with NewInstantQuery at line 186 and NewRangeQuery at line 190. Must add ExplainQuery(ctx context.Context, qs string) (*promql.QueryPlan, error) method.

EngineWithFallback struct (line 20) implements promql.QueryEngine by wrapping preferred and fallback engines. Has NewInstantQuery at line 50 and NewRangeQuery at line 79. Must add ExplainQuery that delegates to preferred engine with fallback logic.

UnlimitedMemoryTrackerPromQLEngine struct (line 61) wraps *promql.Engine and implements promql.QueryEngine. Has NewInstantQuery at line 69 and NewRangeQuery at line 77. Must add ExplainQuery that delegates to inner engine.
Contains fakeEngineThatSupportsLimitedQueries and fakeEngineThatSupportsAllQueries test structs that implement promql.QueryEngine. Both must add ExplainQuery method.
Uses QueryEngine as a field type for rule evaluation. No changes needed unless it wants to call ExplainQuery.
Uses QueryEngine via LazyLoader (line 78). No changes needed - it just holds a reference to the interface.
Uses promql.QueryEngine for PromQL testing framework. No changes needed as it just accepts the interface.

thanos.impact: Thanos uses promql.QueryEngine in its query frontend via the thanos-io/promql-engine library. Its remoteEngine in pkg/query/remote_engine.go implements api.RemoteEngine (a different interface from thanos-io/promql-engine/api) with different method signatures, NOT promql.QueryEngine directly. Thanos would be impacted when it upgrades its vendored prometheus dependency, but the remoteEngine does not need direct changes for this interface addition. Any Thanos components that construct a promql.Engine (the concrete Prometheus type) will get the new method automatically.

grafana.impact: Grafana uses Prometheus's promql.Engine directly for running PromQL queries against Prometheus datasources. Grafana does not have its own implementation of promql.QueryEngine - it uses the concrete *promql.Engine type. No changes needed in Grafana itself; it will get the new method when it upgrades its prometheus dependency.

loki.impact: Loki vendors prometheus/prometheus and has a copy at vendor/github.com/prometheus/prometheus/promql/engine.go. The vendored copy will be updated automatically when Loki runs go mod vendor after upgrading the prometheus dependency.

mimir.impact: Mimir has THREE implementations of promql.QueryEngine that ALL require the new ExplainQuery method: (1) streaming Engine in pkg/streamingpromql/engine.go, (2) EngineWithFallback in pkg/streamingpromql/compat/fallback_engine.go, (3) UnlimitedMemoryTrackerPromQLEngine in pkg/util/limiter/unlimited_memory_consumption_tracker.go. Plus two test fakes in fallback_engine_test.go.

answer.summary: The QueryEngine interface is defined at promql/engine.go:124-128 in prometheus/prometheus with two methods: NewInstantQuery and NewRangeQuery. Adding ExplainQuery requires: (1) defining a new QueryPlan type, (2) adding the method to the interface, (3) implementing it on the Engine struct in the same file. Cross-repo, Mimir (grafana/mimir) is the most impacted with 3 production implementations and 2 test fakes that must all add the new method. Thanos's remoteEngine implements a different interface (api.RemoteEngine) and is NOT directly affected. Grafana uses the concrete *promql.Engine type and gets the method automatically. Loki's vendored copy updates via go mod vendor.
